title: A review loop for small teams
text: A small annotation project should separate labeling from review. Import a dataset, label each item, then approve or return it with a reason. Keep a stable source identifier so a later export can explain where each decision came from. This synthetic note is included to demonstrate traceable search.

title: Local knowledge search
text: 我们希望知识库支持中文检索。项目资料留在本地，检索结果带来源和稳定编号；已导入不等于已阅读，已阅读也不等于原始历史完整。

title: Reading is a separate step
text: A useful knowledge library should distinguish imported records from reviewed excerpts. Updating a source invalidates its old review marks. Keyword matches are retrieval evidence; they do not prove that a generated answer is correct.
